item.title: Route 840 vehicle stop leads to DWI arrest
item.description: A Pulaski man faces a laundry list of charges after a traffic stop by New Hartford Police on Thursday.

item.title: New Hartford Police stop skid steer scheme
item.description: New Hartford Police stopped the sale and attempted theft of a skid steer at the Slocum-Dickson Medical Center over the weekend, and the suspect is now facing several charges.

item.title: Richfield Springs CSD beginning superintendent search
item.description: The Richfield Springs Central School has begun its search for a new superintendent, and is asking for the public's help to find their prime candidate.

item.title: Utica Police searching for suspect in Genesee Street stabbing
item.description: UTICA, NY (WUTR/WFXV/WPNY) -- Utica Police are asking for the public's help in a stabbing on Genesee Street over the weekend that has left one person hospitalized.

item.title: Hiker missing Thursday found dead near Mount Marcy
item.description: A hiker who called 911 after reportedly slipping off a hiking trail Thursday afternoon lost their life that evening, according to New York officials.

item.title: New York Democrat pushes solar legislation while Republicans want more local control
item.description: New York State Senator Pete Harckham has introduced a suite of legislation to promote solar energy, including faster local permits, tax credits, and a mandate for state-owned properties to install solar panels.

item.title: New York state pension fund valued at $297b amid calls to divest from ICE-linked tech
item.description: New York's pension fund, worth $297.8 billion, earned a 2.44% return in Q3 and 12.50% in the first nine months of the fiscal year, with a portfolio consisting of 40% public equities, 13.8% private equity, 23.3% cash, bonds, and mortgages, 14% real estate, and 8.9% credit, absolute return strategies, and opportunistic alternatives.
